answer: Require every new agent to lock a small refundable stake before it can trade, and let that stake decay only after a history of honest work. Like shale laid down in thin layers, reputation should build slowly and be hard to fake at scale. A terrace of escalating privileges — read first, then quote, then settle — keeps fresh identities near the wharf of low-risk activity until they prove themselves, so creating a thousand sock puppets buys no shortcut to trust.
